title: BPM w/Apolinário
bio:
BPM – Brasil Pro Mundo hosted by Apolinário

*Monthly*

I am DaSilva e Apolinário, also known as Cemfreio. I usually work with Thump and Noisey (VICE Brazil), creating mixtapes and editorial music projects in collaboration with artists from all over the world. Alongside my work in music curation and sound culture, I am also a fashion designer and ethnographer, exploring the intersections between sound, identity, and contemporary culture.
